proposals.evidence: Nordic technology provider for sovereign cloud. Kumorion provides the cloud platform layer that lets cloud service providers and data centers deliver sovereign, enterprise-grade cloud service to their customers.
decision_path: data_center_operators: no, it owns no facility
power_equipment, cooling_heat_recovery, computing_network_equipment: no, it supplies no hardware
automation_software: yes, operational software (OpenStack, Kubernetes, secrets and AI-workload management platform for cloud providers and data centers)
proposals.rationale: Dominant role is supplying a cloud platform software layer to data centers and cloud providers. No hardware, no facility, no services-only role. Operational software is the closest fit; other_technology is only for products no specific category covers.
